brands.evidence: Perks and Max can be, but only if you'd use the perks anyway.

client_claims.text: Extra, Perks and Max cost £3, £9 and £19 a month
client_claims.note: Matches the plan prices; Max is 'from £19'.

client_claims.text: The price rose by £2 in August 2026. That rise applied to Perks and Max. Extra stayed at £3.
client_claims.note: No fact covers a price rise.

client_claims.text: Extra includes an extra 0.25 points of interest on savings
client_claims.note: Facts give only the free plan rate of 2.80%.

client_claims.text: Perks includes a weekly Greggs treat, a monthly cinema ticket and an annual Railcard, which Monzo says are worth over £300 a year
client_claims.note: Perks contents not covered by facts.

client_claims.text: Max adds worldwide travel insurance, phone insurance, and UK and Europe breakdown cover
Max has a 3-month minimum and is for ages 18–69; adding family costs extra
Free account already includes spending notifications, budgeting tools and savings pots
